pages.text: [#](53341a)A medium working for raising a grove where none stood. Drop the sapling for the woodland you want at the center, then prepare the rite. Oak, spruce, birch, jungle, rowan, alder, and hawthorn each answer to their own sapling.[#]()
pages.title: Rite of the Forest

pages.text: [#](53341a)Offer a **Wicker Bundle**, a **Brew of Sprouting**, and an **Ent Twig** around the circle, with at least **4000 altar power**. A bound waystone in range can raise the grove there instead.[#]()
pages.title: The Working

pages.text: [#](53341a)Learn it early if you mean to explore plantcraft, Ents, or living-wood paths.[#]()
